messages:
Tara (Marketing): Quick note  blog + benchmark goes live in ~20m. Need one-line exec quote, press kit link, and triage channel. @Evan @Sonia please.
Evan (Comms): Drafting quote. Recommend DM-first to a small reporter list, then stagger social. Any legal constraints?
Sonia (Legal): Include 'No customer data was used.' Use product casing: 'Redwood Optimize'. Avoid comparative language about competitors.
Pri (Product): Appendix updated with configs. Link in press kit. Confirmed no customer data used.
Tara (Marketing): Press kit uploading now, will paste S3 link when done. Roo please stand up triage channel.
press-monitor-bot: Monitoring enabled. Will post pickups >2k reach to #press-clips.
Roo (Support): Triage channel ready: #optimize-press-help. Added quick FAQ and escalation steps to eng-runtime.
Evan (Comms): Exec quote set: "Redwood Optimize helps engineering teams cut inference cost while preserving latency. See appendix for methodology." Holding social until I give the green.
Tara (Marketing): Great. Keep replies minimal here so we have a clean T+30 readout
